- [RARC.1.2] **Tier mechanism (topology-agnostic).** The runtime implements
  the language-side tier contract from
  [LTIE] as a mechanism. Each tier
  is one engine, with its own working memory, cache ([LTIE.5.2]), clock, dialect
  and stream. Tier-to-tier transport is integrator-supplied, and fact flow is
  upward-only. **The runtime does not
  commit to a tier count or topology:** the integrator builds the topology by
  creating one engine per tier and bridging them.
